summary: Arrive AI Inc. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $14,967,247 of its common stock through agent Maxim Group LLC. Shares are sold at market prices; last sale was $0.56 on June 11, 2026. Compensation to Maxim is 2.5% of gross proceeds. There are no escrow arrangements. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation.
